buyer.segment: Bootstrapped SaaS founders with happy paying users who are preparing a launch or sales-page refresh.
buyer.whyChosen: Existing customers make testimonial collection actionable. This narrower buyer is preferable to pre-revenue founders without customer evidence.
buyer.buyingProblemOrTrigger: They need customer proof for an upcoming selling moment and can authorize a software purchase themselves.

tasks.title: Validate access and offer
tasks.instruction: Perform the access check and inspect Senja's actual plans, paid capabilities, and purchase path. Do not propose payment until the offer is verified.
tasks.activityToRecord: Suitable discussions, applicable rules, and verified paid offer.

tasks.title: Prepare a useful demonstration
tasks.instruction: Prepare one short walkthrough showing how a founder could create a collection form and gather a customer testimonial. Use sample content clearly marked as such.

tasks.title: Participate selectively
tasks.instruction: Review up to ten recent discussions and make up to five individually relevant replies where rules allow. Ask about their collection obstacle; offer the walkthrough without promising sales gains.
tasks.activityToRecord: Posts reviewed, buyer fit, replies published, and responses.

tasks.title: Support interested founders
tasks.instruction: Answer responses. Invite interested founders to collect one real testimonial in Senja; discuss the verified paid offer only when it meets their stated need.
tasks.activityToRecord: Buying needs, activation, objections, and checkout outcomes.

tasks.title: Make the next decision
tasks.instruction: Review evidence after seven days and choose whether to repeat, revise, or pause.
tasks.activityToRecord: Separate engagement, usage, and revenue evidence.

channel.name: Permission-based participation in Indie Hackers discussions
channel.fallback: If access fails, check r/SaaS for a current, explicitly permitted feedback or promotion thread serving the same buyer. Proceed only if suitable founders and posting permission are evident; otherwise pause publication.
channel.whyChosen: Posts can reveal an immediate trigger before contact, unlike broad cold outreach. With no previous acquisition efforts, no paying customers, and no budget, this tests problem relevance without building a prospect database.
channel.accessCheck: Read current community rules and search recent posts for 'first customers', 'launch', and 'testimonials'. Identify three suitable founders and confirm a free, permitted reply route before preparing promotion.
channel.whereAndHow: Find recent founder milestone and launch posts; contribute relevant public replies and introduce Senja only where permitted and useful.

resources.basis: Founder supplied three hours weekly and zero monthly budget. Tasks allocate 150 minutes, reserving 30 for interruptions and follow-up.

successCriteria.adjustWhen: Relevant replies without activation warrant examining onboarding or offer fit; insufficient permitted exposure warrants changing execution.
successCriteria.continueWhen: Provisionally continue if two qualified conversations emerge and one founder activates; test the verified paid offer where appropriate.
successCriteria.reconsiderWhen: Reconsider if suitable buyers cannot be reached permissibly or qualified conversations repeatedly reveal no collection need. Silence or one week alone does not establish absent demand.
successCriteria.evidenceToCollect: Record replies separately from qualified interest: an authorized founder with a current need considering Senja. Activation is collecting a real testimonial; adoption requires repeated use. Only completed payment confirms revenue.

importantUnknowns: Actual pricing and paid value relative to the buyer's need.
Whether active, relevant discussions permit product participation.

note: Database output is deeply equal to original activated API output. JSONB key ordering is ignored. First checkbox completion is a persistence test, not an observed acquisition outcome.
